The shell was not barred, and permissions.allow is not a barrier at all. A changed raw file would have been caught afterwards by the control lock, not prevente

The carries' context_id and attempt match the execution block of the matching worker result for all four workers. I could not check the carries against audit/schemas/carry.schema.json because that schema is not among this stage's inputs; I saw only that each carry has the expected key set.

The refund_rate_basis ruling (paying_customers) decides the headline refund rate. On paying customers it is 0.473684 (27/57); on order rows it would be 0.189655 (33/174), a factor of 2.498. The risk register's '2.5x' is right, and the spec comment's 'roughly a factor of three' overstates it.

The refund rate counts a customer as refunded after any refund, full or partial. 21 of the 33 refunded delivered orders in the period are partial refunds. summary: One material blocker. The report's closing sentence says the country figures sum to the headline on a pre-refund basis. That is false: the net country figures sum to the net headline (35741.52), and the pre-refund figures sum to 40235.02, a gap of 4493.50. I recomputed every published number myself from raw_data/orders.csv (40 comparisons over the registry, claims, answers and exclusions): all of them, and all 21 rendered numbers on the three release surfaces, match exactly.
